t: Girlfriends: Willie Or Won't He III: This Time It's Personal
st: Willie Or Won't He III: This Time It's Personal
d: After years of on-again, off-again dating and a pair of broken engagements, William and Monica finally tie the knot. At the reception, Robert Dooling, one of William’s biggest clients, thanks him for delaying his honeymoon to oversee an important merger.

After Aaron and Joan experience an uncomfortable moment when they run into one of Aaron's ex-girlfriends, they decide to discuss their past relationships with one another to avoid future awkward moments.

After splitting from Eldon over his objection to pre-marital sex, Lynn longs to get back together. She feels they share a special connection, but Eldon doesn’t appreciate Lynn’s attempts to seduce him.

t: Girlfriends: A Dingo Ate My Dream House
st: A Dingo Ate My Dream House
d: Tired of all the inconveniences of living in the suburbs, Darnell (Khalil Kain) suggests to Maya (Golden Brooks) they should move back to the city, but Maya disagrees and does not want to give up her new home.

Ever since Monica left William, his life’s been a mess. He can’t work, eat or function normally. Because Joan, Maya, and Lynn feel responsible for driving Monica away, they decide they’ve got to do something to bring the couple back together.
When Lynn's (Persia White) new boyfriend Eldon (Kadeem Hardison), finds himself at odds with the church members over his choice of having Lynn as a girlfriend, he is faced with a tough decision.

t: Girlfriends: To Be Determined / It's Been Determined
st: To Be Determined / It's Been Determined
d: Joan (Tracee Ellis Ross) unexpectedly proposes to Aaron (guest star Richard T. Jones), but when he stumbles on his response, Joan decides the relationship is over and walks away.
Joan (Tracee Ellis Ross) unexpectedly proposes to Aaron (guest star Richard T. Jones), but when he stumbles on his response, Joan decides the relationship is over and walks away.
When Joan buys an expensive new kitchen range for their new house, her fiance Aaron gets upset that she spent money without discussing it with him.

In order to prevent Aaron from going to Iraq, Joan kidnaps him and takes him to Mexico. In Mexico, Aaron explains to Joan that he cannot run away from the war and suggests they get married before he leaves.

When Lynn meets Xander, a cute student at UCLA, he asks her to perform at a rally raising awareness to save the environment. But when Lynn's manager gets her a gig at the House of Blues for the same day, she must decide where she will perform.
Maya tries to avoid calls from her publisher when she experiences writer's block and is unable to complete her third book.
When Maya accuses Darnell of blaming her for the miscarriage, Joan and Lynn are worried that Maya is in denial and not allowing herself to grieve.
Joan is convinced that Maya is not coping with the recent loss of her baby, and decides a little retail therapy will help her recover.

At a gathering to celebrate William and Monica's pregnancy, Maya makes a joke that the baby is hers. Worried that Maya is having trouble dealing with the loss of their baby, Darnell confronts Maya and learns that she has been taking pills to help her cope
Lynn calls Joan, Maya, and William old after realizing they never go out anymore. They decide to prove Lynn wrong by joining her for a night on the town at a hot new club.

t: Girlfriends: R-E-S-P-E-C-T, Find Out What It Means to William

t: Girlfriends: Deck the Halls With Bags and Folly
st: Deck the Halls With Bags and Folly
d: Joan joins a support group for people who have relatives serving in Iraq but is upset when she finds out they are not planning a holiday party due to financial restraints.
Maya and Darnell romanticize the idea of adopting until they attend a neighborhood group for people who have adopted children and are offered a baby girl to adopt.

Joan goes to the school where Aaron used to teach in order to read a letter he sent to his former students. However, when Joan arrives, the students give her a hard time so Maya decides to use her street smarts to help Joan get through to the students.
Lynn gets upset when she learns that her record label is pushing back the release of her album to promote another artist, Chrisette Michele.

Four girlfriends: picky lawyer Joan, gold-digging real estate agent Toni, professional student Lynn, and Joan's headstrong assistant Maya get involved with each other's loves and lives, particularly after Toni starts dating Joan's ex.
Joan, who hasn't had sex in a year, decides to have a one-night stand with handsome restaurateur Davis.

Joan, Toni, and Lynn decide to find dates on the Internet. When Joan meets Marcus she thinks he is too good to be true until she finds out he wears a girdle. Toni breaks it off with her date simply because he's too black.
Joan's new boyfriend Marcus has been moving a bit too fast and she realizes her heart was not in the relationship in the first place.
With Maya and Joan becoming close friends, Toni becomes jealous and feels she's losing her best friend.

t: Girlfriends: The Importance of Being Frank
d: Joan starts dating her client's very attractive accountant Keith, only to be stalked by his estranged wife.
Joan learns that Maya's husband may be cheating on her and must face whether or not it's a good idea to tell her friend. Toni dates a City Councilman who can help further her career.
Maya and her partner Darnell decide they want to renew their vows and have a formal wedding ceremony. Joan offers to help with the event and to have it at her home.

t: Girlfriends: The Remains of the Date
d: Joan is determined to play the ultimate Halloween prank on William and succeeds. Meanwhile, Toni is left to deal with her dates strange sexual fetish for stuffed animals.
On a holiday that emphasizes togetherness, Joan struggles with feelings of loneliness and separation on Thanksgiving.

Baby has never been in Joan's vocabulary until she gets the scare of her life and a new perspective on her priorities. As a result, the girls come together to give their love and support, showing their true Girlfriend friendship.
Dreading another dateless weekend, the girls and William try Maya's suggestion to make a list of what they want in a mate.
Joan's new boyfriend Sean has not made a move on her after three weeks of dating and she is beginning to wonder why.
Joan begins to question her relationship with Sean when he gives her a power drill for Valentine's and doesn't hear from him for three days.
Joan decides it is time to give in on her three-month rule and she is finally going to have sex with her boyfriend Sean.
Joan and Toni decide that Lynn needs to learn to be independent. They give her a week to find a job, then she is on her own.
Joan discovers that being the only black woman at her firm has many disadvantages and she is constantly ignored and overlooked.
Maya checks into the hospital for her fibroid surgery and Joan has trouble managing her time between her boyfriend and her friends.
